name: @w6w-apps/clockodo
description: Track time with Clockodo: time entries, the running clock, customers, projects, services, users and absences.

w6w.longDescription:
Clockodo is a German time-tracking and time-reporting service. This app lists, reads, creates, edits and deletes time entries (as a time span, a lump sum or a lump-sum service), and starts, reads and stops the running clock.

It also manages the master data entries are booked against — customers, projects (with budgets, deadlines and completion) and services — reads users and the authenticated user, and records, approves and deletes absences such as holidays and sick days.

The health check tracks whether the Clockodo API is serving; Clockodo publishes no status page.
